blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The proposed amendments reviewed by the House budget subcommittee originated from government agencies, rejecting the suggestion that individual lawmakers could simply introduce projects of their own choosing through the panel, according to Camarines Sur 4th District Rep. Arnie Fuentebella. Fuentebella, a member of the Nationalist People’s Coalition, said the Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee (BARSc) examined agency requests before presenting proposed changes to the House plenary for approval. “BARC doesn’t discuss anything that didn’t come from them [agencies],” Fuentebella said at a press conference on Monday. “It’s not what Congressman A wants that gets followed.
